tema: Use Blade components for reusable UI
descripcion: Extract repeated markup into named Blade components
hacer: Use x-* components with @props for all reusable UI
no_hacer: Duplicate HTML blocks across views

descripcion: Define one master layout and extend it per page
hacer: @extends layout with named @section blocks
no_hacer: Duplicate header/footer HTML in every view
ejemplo_mal: Full HTML in every view file

descripcion: Declare accepted props inside components with @props
hacer: @props with defaults to document component API
no_hacer: Pass arbitrary variables without declaration

descripcion: Build class strings conditionally without ternary noise
hacer: @class directive for conditional class binding
no_hacer: String concatenation or nested ternaries

tema: Use named slots for flexible layouts
descripcion: Named slots let callers inject content into specific regions
hacer: @slot('header') and $slot for flexible component APIs
no_hacer: Hard-code all sub-sections inside components

tema: Use Blade directives instead of raw PHP
descripcion: Blade directives are readable and IDE-supported
hacer: @if @foreach @forelse @empty instead of <?php ?>
no_hacer: Raw PHP tags inside Blade templates

descripcion: Use double curly braces for XSS-safe output
hacer: {{ }} for all user-supplied or dynamic text
no_hacer: {!! !!} for untrusted data

descripcion: Vite integration handles cache busting and HMR automatically
hacer: @vite(['resources/css/app.css' 'resources/js/app.js'])
no_hacer: Manual script/link tags with hardcoded paths

descripcion: Two-way data binding keeps component state in sync
hacer: wire:model for all form inputs managed by Livewire
no_hacer: Manual JavaScript listeners syncing to component

descripcion: Validate on input rather than only on submit
hacer: wire:model.live + #[Validate] for instant feedback
no_hacer: Only validate on form submit
ejemplo_mal: <input wire:model="email"> with validate() on submit only

descripcion: Bind UI events to component methods cleanly
hacer: wire:click for buttons and interactive elements
no_hacer: JavaScript fetch calls replicating Livewire actions

descripcion: mount() for init; updated() for reactive side effects
hacer: mount() for initialization updatedFoo() for property changes
no_hacer: Heavy logic in render() or __construct()

tema: Use lazy loading for heavy components
descripcion: Defer render of expensive components until visible
hacer: wire:init or lazy attribute on components
no_hacer: Load all Livewire components on page load
ejemplo_mal: <livewire:analytics-chart /> with heavy DB queries on mount

tema: Integrate Alpine.js for local UI state
descripcion: Use Alpine.js for UI-only state that doesn't need server round-trips
hacer: x-data / x-show / x-transition for tooltips dropdowns
no_hacer: Livewire server calls for purely visual toggle state

descripcion: Always indicate to users when a server action is in progress
hacer: wire:loading.attr="disabled" and wire:loading elements
no_hacer: Provide no feedback while Livewire request is in flight

descripcion: Livewire's trait manages chunked upload and temp storage
hacer: WithFileUploads trait + wire:model for file inputs
no_hacer: Manual multipart form submissions for Livewire pages

tema: Use Inertia page components as route endpoints
descripcion: Each page is a Vue/React component rendered server-side via Inertia::render()
hacer: Inertia::render('Dashboard' ['data' => $data]) in controllers
no_hacer: Return JSON and fetch from JavaScript

descripcion: Middleware share() provides auth user and flash to every page
hacer: Share auth/flash in HandleInertiaRequests middleware
no_hacer: Pass auth to every Inertia::render() call

descripcion: Inertia Link intercepts clicks for SPA-like transitions
hacer: <Link href="/dashboard"> instead of <a href>
no_hacer: Regular <a> tags for internal navigation

tema: Use useForm for form state and submission
descripcion: Inertia's useForm manages progress errors and transforms
hacer: useForm for all page-level forms, form.post() for submit
no_hacer: Axios/fetch for form submissions on Inertia pages

tema: Use persistent layouts to preserve state
descripcion: Wrap pages in a persistent layout so header/sidebar don't remount
hacer: layout property on page component for persistent UI
no_hacer: Re-render full layout on every page visit
ejemplo_mal: No layout — full page reload feel on navigation

descripcion: Server-side rendering improves SEO and first paint
hacer: Enable Inertia SSR for marketing and public pages
no_hacer: Client-only rendering for all pages including public
ejemplo_mal: No SSR on pages requiring good SEO

tema: Set up Tailwind CSS via Vite
descripcion: Use Vite + tailwindcss plugin for fast HMR and optimized builds
hacer: Install tailwindcss @tailwindcss/vite and configure vite.config.js
no_hacer: Laravel Mix or manual PostCSS pipeline for new projects
ejemplo_mal: Laravel Mix with require('tailwindcss') in webpack

tema: Purge unused styles via content config
descripcion: Tailwind scans Blade and JS files to tree-shake unused classes
hacer: content: ['./resources/views/**/*.blade.php', './resources/js/**/*.{js,vue}']
no_hacer: No content config — ship all 3MB of CSS

descripcion: class-based dark mode integrates with server-rendered preference
hacer: darkMode: 'class' with a toggle that sets class on <html>
no_hacer: Media query only — no user override possible

descripcion: Extract only truly repeated multi-class patterns
hacer: @apply for BEM base classes shared across many components
no_hacer: @apply for every single element — defeats Tailwind's purpose

tema: Configure custom design tokens in CSS
descripcion: Define brand colors spacing fonts as CSS variables consumed by Tailwind
hacer: Custom @theme tokens matched to brand guidelines
no_hacer: Magic color hex codes scattered across Blade templates

tema: Use anonymous Blade components for UI primitives
descripcion: Blade files in resources/views/components/ auto-register as x-* components
hacer: Anonymous components for buttons alerts badges cards
no_hacer: Blade @includes for anything reusable

tema: Use class-based components for complex logic
descripcion: PHP class components can inject services and pre-process data
hacer: app/View/Components/ class when component needs PHP logic
no_hacer: Blade @php blocks for business logic inside templates

descripcion: Pass through HTML attributes like class id aria to root element
hacer: $attributes->merge() on root element of components
no_hacer: Ignore caller-provided HTML attributes silently
ejemplo_mal: <div class="btn"> — drops extra class/id from caller

descripcion: Keep variant/size/color logic in a PHP class or helper not in Blade
hacer: Variant class or match() expression in component class
no_hacer: Long @if chains for variants inside Blade templates
ejemplo_bien: public function classes(): string { return match($this->variant) { 'primary' => 'bg-blue-600', } }

descripcion: Use {{ $slot ?? '' }} or named slot defaults so components are usable empty
hacer: Default content in slots for optional regions
no_hacer: Require every slot to be filled — throws errors on empty usage

descripcion: Prefix third-party or module components to avoid collisions
hacer: Register custom prefix via Blade::componentNamespace()
no_hacer: Mix first-party and package component names with no prefix

descripcion: Move validation rules out of controllers into dedicated FormRequest classes
hacer: php artisan make:request and define rules() + authorize()
no_hacer: Inline validate() in controller actions
ejemplo_bien: class StorePostRequest extends FormRequest { public function rules() { return ['title' => 'required|max:255']; } }

tema: Preserve old input on validation failure
descripcion: Use old() to repopulate form fields after server-side error redirect
hacer: old('field') as default value on all form inputs
no_hacer: Empty form fields when validation fails

descripcion: Use the @error directive for inline field-level error messages
hacer: @error('field') to show per-field messages
no_hacer: Dump $errors->all() in one block at top of form

tema: Use CSRF token on all forms
descripcion: CSRF protection is enabled by default — include @csrf in every form
hacer: @csrf in every POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE form
no_hacer: Disable VerifyCsrfToken middleware for convenience

descripcion: HTML forms only support GET/POST — use @method for REST actions
hacer: @method('PUT') inside form for update/delete routes
no_hacer: Route::post for all mutations including updates

descripcion: Flash success/error in controller; read in layout with session()
hacer: session('status') in layout for global flash display
no_hacer: Re-query DB or pass flash from every controller individually

tema: Eager load relationships to prevent N+1
descripcion: Always eager load related models used in views with with()
hacer: with() in queries before passing collections to views
no_hacer: Lazy-load relations inside Blade loops

descripcion: Use cache() helper to wrap expensive rendered partials
hacer: cache() around slow partials that change infrequently
no_hacer: Re-render identical content on every request

descripcion: Always paginate collections in list views
hacer: ->paginate() or ->simplePaginate() with {{ $items->links() }}
no_hacer: ->get() for large tables in views

descripcion: Offload emails notifications and heavy processing to queues
hacer: Dispatch jobs for anything taking >200ms
no_hacer: Block HTTP request with slow operations

descripcion: Laravel resolves models automatically — avoids manual find()
hacer: Type-hint model in controller method
no_hacer: Manual User::findOrFail($id) in every method
ejemplo_bien: public function show(User $user): View { return view('users.show' compact('user')); }

tema: Enable HTTP response caching for static content
descripcion: Cache control headers for pages that rarely change
hacer: Cache-Control headers via middleware for public pages
no_hacer: No caching — serve every response fresh
ejemplo_mal: No cache headers on marketing pages

descripcion: {{ }} auto-escapes HTML — never use {!! !!} on user data
hacer: {{ }} for all untrusted or dynamic content
no_hacer: {!! !!} for user-controlled strings

tema: Protect routes with Gate and Policy
descripcion: Use policies for authorization — never inline permission checks in views
hacer: @can / Gate::allows() for UI visibility; policy()->authorize() for actions
no_hacer: Hardcode role checks inline across templates

descripcion: Check MIME type size and store outside public root
hacer: Store in storage/app/private + validate mimes and max
no_hacer: Store raw upload in public/ without validation
ejemplo_mal: 'avatar' => 'required' with no MIME or size check

tema: Use signed URLs for temporary links
descripcion: Generate expiring URLs for private downloads or email confirmations
hacer: URL::signedRoute() or temporarySignedRoute()
no_hacer: Expose sequential IDs in download URLs without auth
ejemplo_mal: route('file.download' $id) with no expiry or signature

tema: Set a strict Content Security Policy
descripcion: CSP headers prevent XSS injection of external scripts
hacer: spatie/laravel-csp or custom middleware to emit CSP header
no_hacer: No CSP — browser runs any injected script
